name: Skin-shaped offset arc + self-aligning cuff (non-spherical trombone)
verdict: dead as specified: gap 133.1 vs 68.9 for the spherical 3R; not worth a GPU sweep. The offsets + self-aligning stage gain 11 points over its own spherical version with slides <= 4 mm, but the rigid circular band's tail (past the guide) cannot clear the neck/trapezius overhead at any radius, so the band sits 114 mm from its axis (> 31 mm off the skin). Successor: stow the tail (coil-stowed arc).
limiter: band tail past the guide (azimuth 106-126 deg about the J2 line) inside the body at every radius in 13-25 of 180 fit poses (the whole Raise-overhead clip, pl30 el66-150 ax-43..-60); group rigid need p50 62 mm but p94 114 mm; band/guide/connector in-band 0-0.7 % (median > 31 mm off the skin); J2 offsets > 6 mm need > +-5 mm radial slide in 48-169/220 poses; 38 workspace poses (behind-back, plane -90..-75) put the guide off the arc
note: 47 configurations (a first pass with a saturated-height bug was discarded); spherical reference without stage 144.47; per-part in-band: rail 67 %, J1 ring 61 %, carriage 42 %, band 0.7 %, guide 0 % | best sweep entry k=38; bench fast 60/160 | AUDIT 2026-10-15T19:50:48Z: death upheld - re-measured k=38 on Bench(60,160) fast: identical (gap 133.12); band-percentile scan p40-80 gives rho ~72 mm but gap 224-249 (contact 42-63 %, in-band <= 0.37); band is 37 of 39 contact poses

manufacturability.reason: 3-translation self-aligning stage (25 / 10 / 5 mm) is over the cap; no radial component fits in band

mechanism.notes: offset trombone + 3-slide cuff stage (NOT BUILDABLE: 3P, the radial slide has no compact part). bodies: link 1 (ring upper race + guide box), link 2 (Ti band + connector), E (hub-3 lower plate), across carriage C, along carriage A (carries the across rail), arm-fixed rail (arm-end). joints: J1 KAA15XL0 ring, J2 band sliding through the guide, J3 O20 hub, radial pin slide, across and along miniature rolling guides. Slides change no orientation: not sensed. custom: base housing, guide box, band, connector, E, C, A, rail mount, J3 shaft, 2 radial pins (est.); catalogue: KAA15XL0, MR117 pair, ~4 guide rollers, 2 LWL3/RSR3 blocks + 2 rails, 2 pin bushings (est.).
